mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_invoice_reimburse (reimburse_id, invoice_id, reimburse_user, reimburse_department, reimburse_amount, reimburse_reason, reimburse_status, apply_time, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reimburseId}, #{invoiceId}, #{reimburseUser}, #{reimburseDepartment}, #{reimburseAmount}, #{reimburseReason}, #{reimburseStatus}, #{applyTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice_reimburse SET reimburse_user = #{reimburseUser}, reimburse_department = #{reimburseDepartment}, reimburse_amount = #{reimburseAmount}, reimburse_reason = #{reimburseReason}, reimburse_status = #{reimburseStatus}, approver = #{approver}, approve_remark = #{approveRemark}, apply_time = #{applyTime}, approve_time = #{approveTime}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE reimburse_id = #{reimburseId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_invoice_reimburse WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} ORDER BY apply_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_invoice_reimburse WHERE reimburse_user = #{reimburseUser} ORDER BY apply_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_invoice_reimburse WHERE reimburse_status = #{reimburseStatus} ORDER BY apply_time
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice_reimburse SET reimburse_status = #{status}, approver = #{approver}, approve_remark = #{remark}, approve_time = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE reimburse_id = #{reimburseId}
